# Security

This fork adds the Companion to [HealthLog](https://github.com/anym001/healthlog) and handles personal health
data, so please report problems privately: use **Report a vulnerability** on this repository's Security tab.

Report anything in `companion/`, `compose.companion.yml` or `compose.local.yml` here, and anything in HealthLog
itself to its maintainer. This is a personal, self-hosted project: there is no bounty and no response deadline.
